hook: Voice AI still cannot understand Kenyan speech.
hookText: Voice AI struggles with Kenyan speech

beats.say: Voice AI still struggles with Kenyan speech, and the piece looks at why Swahili and local accents trip up today's systems.
Speech systems learn from the voices they are trained on, so accents and languages with less training data get understood worse.
For millions of speakers, that gap means everyday tools misunderstand them, and closing it starts with better data for their voices.
